<import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        final Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        final Printer out = new Printer(System.out);
        final TaskC solver = new TaskC();
        solver.solve(1, in, out);
        out.close();
    }

    static class TaskC {
        final double eps = 1e-8;

        public void solve(int testNumber, Scanner in, Printer out) {
            final int n = in.nextInt();
            final List<Loop> loops = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                final int x = in.nextInt();
                final int y = in.nextInt();
                final int r = in.nextInt();
                loops.add(new Loop(x, y, r));
            }

            final Set<Point> all = new TreeSet<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
                    final List<Point> inter = intersect(loops.get(i), loops.get(j));
                    if (inter == null) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    all.addAll(inter);
                }
            }

            final Map<Point, Integer> pointId = new TreeMap<>();
            final List<Set<Integer>> adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                final List<Double> angles = new ArrayList<>();
                final int K = 100;
                for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                    angles.add(Math.PI * 2 * j / K);
                }
                for (Point p : all) {
                    if (loops.get(i).contains(p)) {
                        final double dx = p.x - loops.get(i).o.x;
                        final double dy = p.y - loops.get(i).o.y;
                        final double alpha = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
                        if (alpha < 0) {
                            alpha += 2 * Math.PI;
                        }
                        angles.add(alpha);
                    }
                }
                Collections.sort(angles);
                final Point dir = new Point(1, 0).scale(loops.get(i).r);
                final Double[] as = new TreeSet<>(angles).toArray(new Double[0]);
                for (int j = 0; j < as.length; j++) {
                    final Point p = loops.get(i).o.add(dir.rotate(as[j]));
                    getId(p, pointId, adj);
                }
                for (int j = 0; j < as.length; j++) {
                    final Point p = loops.get(i).o.add(dir.rotate(as[j]));
                    final Point q = loops.get(i).o.add(dir.rotate(as[(j + 1) % as.length]));
                    final int u = pointId.get(p);
                    final int v = pointId.get(q);
                    if (u == v) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    adj.get(u).add(v);
                    adj.get(v).add(u);
                }
            }

            final int v = adj.size();
            final int e = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < v; i++) {
                e += adj.get(i).size();
            }
            e /= 2;

            final int comps = 0;
            final boolean[] was = new boolean[v];
            for (int i = 0; i < v; i++) {
                if (!was[i]) {
                    ++comps;
                    dfs(i, was, adj);
                }
            }

            out.println(1 + comps + e - v);
        }

        private void dfs(int i, boolean[] was, List<Set<Integer>> adj) {
            was[i] = true;
            for (int j : adj.get(i)) {
                if (!was[j]) {
                    dfs(j, was, adj);
                }
            }
        }

        private void getId(Point p, Map<Point, Integer> pointId, List<Set<Integer>> adj) {
            if (!pointId.containsKey(p)) {
                int sz = pointId.size();
                pointId.put(p, sz);
                adj.add(new TreeSet<>());
            }
        }

        private List<Point> intersect(Loop c1, Loop c2) {
            final double dx = c1.o.x - c2.o.x;
            final double dy = c1.o.y - c2.o.y;
            final double d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
            final double cos = (c1.r * c1.r + d * d - c2.r * c2.r) / (2 * c1.r * d);
            if (cos < -1 - eps) {
                return null;
            }
            if (cos < -1) {
                cos = -1;
            }
            if (cos > 1 + eps) {
                return null;
            }
            if (cos > 1) {
                cos = 1;
            }
            final List<Point> res = new ArrayList<>();
            final double alpha = Math.acos(cos);
            final Point dir = c2.o.sub(c1.o).norm();
            res.add(c1.o.add(dir.scale(c1.r).rotate(+alpha)));
            res.add(c1.o.add(dir.scale(c1.r).rotate(-alpha)));
            return res;
        }

        class Point implements Comparable<Point> {
            double x;
            double y;

            Point(double x, double y) {
                this.x = x;
                this.y = y;
            }

            Point add(Point o) {
                return new Point(x + o.x, y + o.y);
            }

            Point sub(Point o) {
                return new Point(x - o.x, y - o.y);
            }

            Point rotate(double alpha) {
                final double c = Math.cos(alpha);
                final double s = Math.sin(alpha);
                final double nx = x * c - y * s;
                final double ny = x * s + y * c;
                return new Point(nx, ny);
            }

            Point norm() {
                final double len = length();
                return scale(1.0 / len);
            }

            Point scale(double f) {
                return new Point(f * x, f * y);
            }

            double length() {
                return Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y);
            }

            @Override
            public String toString() {
                return String.format("%.6f %.6f", x, y);
            }

            @Override
            public boolean equals(Object obj) {
                final Point o = (Point) obj;
                return Math.abs(x - o.x) < eps && Math.abs(y - o.y) < eps;
            }

            @Override
            public int compareTo(Point o) {
                if (Math.abs(x - o.x) > eps) {
                    return x < o.x ? -1 : 1;
                }
                if (Math.abs(y - o.y) > eps) {
                    return y < o.y ? -1 : 1;
                }
                return 0;
            }

        }

        class Loop {
            Point o;
            double r;

            Loop(double x, double y, double r) {
                o = new Point(x, y);
                this.r = r;
            }

            boolean contains(Point p) {
                final double dist = p.sub(o).length();
                return Math.abs(dist - r) < eps;
            }

        }

    }

    static class Printer implements AutoCloseable {
        private final PrintWriter writer;

        public Printer(OutputStream stream) {
            writer = new PrintWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(stream));
        }

        public void println(int i) {
            writer.println(i);
        }

        @Override
        public void close() {
            writer.close();
        }

    }

    static class Scanner {
        private final BufferedReader reader;
        private StringTokenizer st;

        public Scanner(InputStream stream) {
            reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(stream));
        }

        public String next() {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
                try {
                    st = new StringTokenizer(reader.readLine());
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    throw new RuntimeException(e);
                }
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        public int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

    }

}
